verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a dedicated keyboard shortcuts feature and JMAP-based sync architecture emphasizing speed, and community feedback corroborates the interface being notably fast ('a ton faster' than alternatives). However, there is no evidence of a command palette or comprehensive shortcut coverage claims, and no hands-on confirmation of full keyboard-only operation. Missing for 10: explicit command-palette feature, evidence of exhaustive/comprehensive shortcut coverage beyond a single help article, independent benchmarking of UI responsiveness under load.
